regularSemanticAssessment: 48 regular originals inspected. iOS preserves Android information order, full-screen private handoff, centered resin reveal/result cards, tactile controls, square board/cell intent and X/O scale/depth. Native safe areas, larger body type/line wrapping and native toggle shape are intentional platform differences; the surfaces retain the established design rather than generic system cards. Selected/winning rings remain unambiguous. Pressed state and timing are assessed in separate interaction evidence, not inferred from stills.
summary: All 96 regular and regular-ax3 originals were opened at full 1206×2622 resolution after the layout fixes, in both themes across all 24 scenarios. The tutorial punctuation defect is fixed; AX3 instruction and board origins are stable across stage snapshots with complete text. Android semantic hierarchy, warm moulded-resin treatment, wordmark identity, X/O colouring, piece depth, tray structure and modal intent are preserved. No new ordinary visual defect found in these 96 captures.
limitations: This is independent visual acceptance for the two named profiles, not certification of unreviewed profiles.
Bottom scenarios explicitly use a bottom scroll anchor; these are not production launch offsets or gesture evidence.
At AX3 ordinary scrolling is required for lower gameplay and long information pages. Top and bottom stills do not alone prove every intermediate target reachable.

Stills cannot establish physical VoiceOver/Switch Control, keyboard interaction, actual sound/haptics, frame pacing, locked-tap handling or terminal timing; separate automated and temporal evidence applies.
Android-to-iOS comparison is semantic; deterministic same-toolchain pixel tolerance is a separate gate.
